extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology; replaced automated locator notes with source-bounded lipid-II binding, negative pore-formation, time-kill context, and structure-activity association claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Estercin A shows lipid II binding activity in a spot-on-lawn competition assay against L. lactis MG1363.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:Estercin A Exhibits Lipid II Binding Activity but Lacks Membrane Pore-Forming Ability; xml:fig=5:Figure 5A

mechanism_claims.limitations: Supports lipid-II binding/cell-wall pathway context; does not alone prove full cell-wall biosynthesis inhibition kinetics or a therapeutic target in vivo.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Under the tested fluorescence microscopy conditions, estercin A did not show nisin-like membrane pore-forming behavior in L. lactis MG1363 cells.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: estercin A against L. lactis MG1363

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:Estercin A Exhibits Lipid II Binding Activity but Lacks Membrane Pore-Forming Ability; xml:fig=5:Figure 5C

mechanism_claims.limitations: Negative pore-forming evidence is bounded to the tested strain, dyes, concentration, and incubation conditions; it is not generalized to every membrane system.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-killing results showed slower killing for estercin A than nisin, consistent with lipid-II binding without pore formation under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: estercin A against L. lactis MG1363

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:Estercin A Exhibits Lipid II Binding Activity but Lacks Membrane Pore-Forming Ability; xml:fig=5:Figure 5B; xml:sec=27:Time Killing Assay of Estercin A Against L. Lactis MG1363

mechanism_claims.limitations: Used as consistency evidence, not as a standalone molecular target assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Figure 7 natural and engineered variant comparisons support a structure-activity association for the unique C-terminal region of estercin A.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: estercin A, estercin A-T, estercin A-G, delta-WG, and G24T variants

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=8:Unique Residues Associated with the Antibacterial Activity of Estercin A; xml:fig=7:Figure 7B-D; SI:Figure S6/S7 text

mechanism_claims.limitations: Supports association between C-terminal changes and activity; it is not promoted to a direct membrane/cell-wall molecular mechanism.

caution_findings.finding: SYTO-9/PI dye descriptions mention DNA binding as dye behavior only; final mechanism curation does not claim nucleic-acid interaction by estercin A.
Lipid-II binding is source-supported, but final wording avoids overclaiming complete cell-wall biosynthesis inhibition kinetics or in vivo target validation.
